newsitem.title: GREECE: Attica Entepr posts strong H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Attica Entepr posts strong H1 results.

text.p: Shipper Attica Enterprises said first half consolidated pretax profit rose 149 percent to 1.072 billion drachmas from 430 million in the first half a year earlier.
The earnings growth was achieved on a strong rise in turnover, up 178 percent to 5.662 billion drachmas versus 2.03 billion in the first half of 1995, the company said.
It said its Superfast I and II ferries operated 294 sailings between Patras, Greece and Ancona, Italy and carried 75,000 passengers, 15,000 private cars and 21,000 trucks.

"In a total of 11 ships operating this line, the two Superfast ferries captured 47 percent of the passenger traffic, 42 percent of the private cars market and 41 percent of the truck traffic," Attica Enterprises said in a statement.
Its Superfast I vessel started operations on April 15 1995 with Superfast II following on June 16.

The figures refer to a period of relatively lower traffic as compared to the second half of the year when especially because of the summer season there is increased demand by passengers, private cars and campers, it said.

Attica Enterprises is closely monitoring the building of its two new vessels, Superfast III and IV, currently under construction at Kvaerner Mass Yards in Finland. It expects delivery in 1998, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
